instruction: Pick up the key, hand it over to the other hand, insert it into the keyhole, then turn it.

arguments.note: The key lies left of the circular lock. Move the left hand above it before turning downward.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 36 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The first move stopped short; finish reaching above the key.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Begin rotating downward above the key in free space.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 36 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Continue toward a straight-down grasp to see the key under the wrist.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The larger rotation was refused; use a smaller orientation change.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 20 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lower while finishing the downward orientation, still above table contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the key behind and left of the hand centre. Align over its bow and approach the table.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Centre the bow between the jaws and descend to just above contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 4 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow is centred laterally. Lower five millimetres toward the flat-key grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Descend the final few millimetres and close around the key bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have caught the blade end. Lift the key clear so the other hand can take its bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 10 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The key is no longer seated between the closed jaws. Open and reassess its settled position before regrasping.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived.

arguments.note: The key has settled farther forward. Approach its round bow for a more secure grasp.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Adjust toward the bow rather than the shaft and lower near contact.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Make a four-millimetre final approach over the bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close gently at table grasp height with the bow centred.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lift the bow grasp slowly to verify that the key follows the hand.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The key slipped back onto the table. Shift the grasp rearward to encompass the bow itself, not its neck.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Align the open jaws directly over the displaced bow before descending again.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The bow remains slightly right and behind the grasp centre; correct before final closure.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Make a small final centring correction over the round bow.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Close on the bow at the table-limited grasp height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: Lift vertically and check whether the bow remains held.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The key is securely lifted. Bring the right hand toward its exposed shaft for the handover.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 35 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Move the receiving hand closer while beginning a downward approach.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 30 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The receiving wrist is too close to the left hand. Raise and orient downward before approaching the exposed key.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 28 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Approach the exposed shaft from above with rotated jaws to avoid the bow-holding fingers.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 19 waypoints (0.8s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.hindsight: The successful bow grasp required a farther rearward alignment. The receiving arm should have been oriented and positioned with greater separation before approaching the held key; the close approach displaced the holding arm and dropped the key.
arguments.reason: The key was lifted, but slipped during the handover approach. Too few environment steps remain to safely regrasp, insert, turn, and return both arms home.

calls.tool_result: Acknowledged give_up.

arguments.hindsight: The successful bow grasp required a farther rearward alignment. The receiving arm should have been oriented and positioned with greater separation before approaching the held key; the close approach displaced the holding arm and dropped the key.
arguments.reason: The key was lifted, but slipped during the handover approach. Too few environment steps remain to safely regrasp, insert, turn, and return both arms home.
